note.description: market-overview-tiered-generator uses total returns (daily_return field from DynamoDB) including dividends/distributions. Calendar date arithmetic (not trading days) for period calculations. Consistent with Yang pipeline benchmark returns. DAILY# entries exclude LATEST to prevent duplicate dates (fix applied 2026-01-13).

market-regime-classifier reads timeseries files from S3 (written by market-rsi-tiered-generator). If timeseries files are stale, regime calculations use outdated return data. Yield curve uses monthly FRED data (433 points from 1990); linear interpolation fills gaps for daily regime history. As of 2026-02-26, a bug was fixed where the rolling percentile window was always empty (range(period, min(period,N)) = always empty).

Fear and Greed component historical data uses raw underlying metrics (e.g., S&P 500 price level for market_momentum, not a normalized 0-100 score). Deduplication by date applied 2026-02-17 to prevent duplicate entries when Lambda runs multiple times per day.

Volatility fetcher runs weekdays only. Weekend VIX/MOVE values are not collected. Regime classification is percentile-based (35-year history) rather than absolute thresholds. Legacy absolute-threshold regimes (VIX_REGIMES, MOVE_REGIMES) kept in response for backward compatibility but percentile-based regime is canonical.

News sentiment (articles.json) uses a 7-day rolling window from opal-news-articles. Previous-day comparison in SentimentHistorical is client-side via localStorage (not server-computed); shows flat change on first load or when localStorage is unavailable.

keyword-intelligence-generator is idempotent — skips keywords already written for today. Continues on per-keyword errors (one failure never aborts the batch). opal-news-ai-sentiment Lambda (FinBERT scorer) source not found in local repo under infra/aws/lambda/; likely managed separately or deployed without a local source directory.

causality-themes-fetcher requires Alpha Vantage API key. If key is unavailable, all ticker enrichment returns None and themes with no ticker data are excluded entirely. Effectively filters out themes with no associated equities. Sector mapping is a hardcoded dict of ~13 tickers — any ticker outside that map returns 'Unknown' sector.

CapitalMarketAssumptions uses demo-mode public endpoints (no auth) per portal-proxy.ts:1168 and :1210. TODOs exist to revert to authenticated shared endpoints for production. CMA data freshness depends on Yang pipeline cadence (typically weekly with new PKL uploads).
